description: Illustrative screening exercise; not an as-built model or forecast of either company's outcome.

reported.fuel_cell_economic_life_years: 20-year PPA S05, used as model recovery life

provenance.assumptions: All other numeric parameters, individual asset partitions, commissioning months, outage blocks, losses, capture rate, prices, financing, load target boundary, and costs are analyst-selected. The historical 1.8 GW announcement is interpreted solely for this exercise as facility load, not IT load or Google's confirmed final demand.
provenance.timing: S04 says energy service late 2027 and peak load 2030; S05 says fuel cells fully operational by end 2028. Model tranche dates are illustrative, not disclosed contracts. No unknown 248 MW is credited.
provenance.capacity_boundary: 5% delivery haircut is a sensitivity allowance, not a measured site derating. Tallgrass 1150 MW already uses site-ready language. Group splits do not represent an actual electrical single-line diagram.
provenance.firm_addition: Hypothetical 100 MW delivered firm AFTER its own contingency allowance; incremental contract cost is not estimated. Must be proven deliverable under modeled largest loss. Not an announced Google asset.
